book.name: 2 Abhatɨsarʉʉnikɨ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhatɨsarʉʉnikɨ

content: Ɨnyarʉbha yɨnʉ nandikirɨ inyɨ Paaurʉ, hamwɨmwɨ na Sirwanʉ
na Timoseo. Tʉrabhaandɨkɨra imwɨ abhiisirirya bhʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Tɨsarʉʉnikɨ, mwiribhita rya abhaatʉ bhanʉ mwisiriiryɨ Bhaabha Mungu nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi no omorembe kurwa kwa Bhaabha Mungu na kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhɨbhɨ na niimwɨ.
Abhiisirirya bharahaabhwa umwʉyʉ ribhaga ryi ɨnyaakʉ
Abhahiiri bhɨɨtʉ, toreenderwa kukumya Mungu ibhaga ryʉsi igʉrʉ waanyu, kʉ kʉbha ubhwisirirya bhwanyu bhʉrakʉra bhʉkʉngʼu, naatu ʉkʉsɨɨgana kwanyu kʉrangʼeha kwaruha.
Na niitwɨ turiiheema mʉmasengerero ga Mungu, kʉ kʉbha yu ubhwigumirirya nu ubhwisirirya bhʉnʉ mʉnabhwɨ, mʉnyaakʉ yʉʉsi yɨnʉ mʉnayo.
Gayo gʉʉsi gareerekenʼya, ɨtɨnɨrʉ ya Mungu ne‑ye eheene. Kʉtɨnɨrʉ yiyo imwɨ mʉrabharwa na mʉrɨɨndibhwa kʉbha mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwazɨ,
Mungu arakora ge eheene, arabhaha ɨnyaakʉ bhanʉ bhakʉbhanyaacha
na kʉbhaha umwoyeero bhanʉ mʉkʉnyaaka, hamwɨmwɨ na niitwɨ. Arakorabhu, hanʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu akuuza kurwa mwisaarʉ hamwɨmwɨ na bhamaraika
nɨ ɨmɨrɨngɨɨri jo omorero. Yɨɨsu newe akʉbhatɨnɨra bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakwanga Mungu, na bhanʉ bhatakwisirirya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu yʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu.
Ɨnyaakʉ yaabhʉ ɨrabha ubhuriki bhwa kemerano na kutuurwa kore nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ nʉ ʉbhʉkʉrʉ bhwʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ.
Ɨnyaakʉ yiyo ɨrabha urusikʉ rʉnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akuuza kukumibhwa nʉ ʉkʉsʉngʼaana ubhusuuku kurwa kʉbharɨndu
bhaazɨ bhanʉ bhamwisiriiryɨ. Na niimwɨ kwikɨ mʉrabha mʉbhayo, kʉ kʉbha mwisiriiryɨ amangʼana garya twabharɨɨtɨɨrɨ.

Kʉgayo tʉrabhasabhɨra ibhaga ryʉsi, korereke Mungu wɨɨtʉ agiryɨ mwikarɨ kʉrɨngʼaana nu ubhubhirikirwa bhwanyu. Naatu tʉramʉsabha, amarɨ amangʼana amazʉmu gʉʉsi ganʉ mukwenda kokora kʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ, na amarɨ emeremo janyu jʉsi ju ubhwisirirya.
Tʉrasabha, korereke iriina ryʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu rɨbhɨ rɨrakumibhwa igʉrʉ waanyu. Na niimwɨ mʉbhɨ mʉrakumibhwa igʉrʉ waazɨ, ɨbhɨgʉngi bhya Mungu wɨɨtʉ na bhyʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.

footnotes.text: Sirwanʉ arabhirikirwa Siira mʉkɨtabhʉ cha Amahocha ga Abhatumwa.
Ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwazɨ. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora ringʼana ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu muKiniibhasa.
Bhamaraika. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora ringʼana maraika muKiniibhasa.
